blocks.title: Hero Simple
blocks.description: A badge, the heading, one paragraph and up to two links as the actions (primary, then secondary), with one picture at the end, at the start (landscape or portrait), on top or at the bottom.

model.title: HeroContent
model.description: Hero content: an optional badge, the heading, a description, one picture (light, optional dark) and up to two actions (the first drawn as the primary button, the second as the secondary one). One object is valid in every hero layout (media at the end, at the start, on top).

badge.description: a short pill above the heading; empty: no badge

description.description: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

image.description: address of the picture (an https URL or a path); none: the placeholder

imageAlt.description: alt text of the picture; none: the title (the placeholder is decorative)

imageDark.description: address of the picture in the dark theme; none: image

actionLabel.description: the label of the action; the link is drawn when the label and the address are both set

secondaryActionLabel.description: the label of the second action (the secondary button after the first); drawn when the label and the address are both set; empty: none

secondaryActionHref.description: the address of the second action

blocks.title: Intro Simple
blocks.description: Text only: a badge, a large heading, one paragraph and up to two links as the actions (primary, then secondary), centred or at the start, in the middle of the section or low in a tall one.

variants.label: Low in the section, at the start

model.title: IntroContent
model.description: Intro content: an optional badge, the heading, a description and up to two actions (the first drawn as the primary button, the second as the secondary one). Text only: one object is valid in every intro layout (centred, at the start, low in the section).

badge.description: a short pill above the heading; empty: no badge

description.description: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

actionLabel.description: the label of the action; the link is drawn when the label and the address are both set

secondaryActionLabel.description: the label of the second action (the secondary button after the first); drawn when the label and the address are both set; empty: none

secondaryActionHref.description: the address of the second action

blocks.title: Gallery Hero
blocks.description: The heading, one paragraph and up to two links as the actions beside three or four photos: at the end, at the start, or in a row under the copy.

model.title: GalleryContent
model.description: Gallery hero content: the heading, a description, up to two actions and three or four photos. One object is valid in every gallery layout (a grid of photos at the end or the start, layered photos at the end or under the copy).

description.description: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

actionLabel.description: the label of the action; the link is drawn when the label and the address are both set

secondaryActionLabel.description: the label of the second action (the secondary button after the first); drawn when the label and the address are both set; empty: none

secondaryActionHref.description: the address of the second action

photos.description: the photos, in the order they are shown (the layout shows three or four)

id.description: stable key of the entry (the Codex entry id)

image.description: address of the photo; none: the placeholder

blocks.title: Split Simple
blocks.description: Two halves: the heading, one paragraph and up to two links as the actions (primary, then secondary) beside one picture that fills its half to the edge of the screen.

variants.label: Picture at the end, to the edge
Picture at the start, to the edge

model.title: SplitContent
model.description: Split content: the copy of one half (the heading, a description and up to two actions: the first drawn as the primary button, the second as the secondary one) and the picture of the other half (light, optional dark), which fills its half. One object is valid in every split layout (the picture at the end, at the start). Other media of the half (video, a sign-in form) are a later version of this model.

description.description: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

image.description: address of the picture (an https URL or a path); none: the placeholder

imageAlt.description: alt text of the picture; none: the title (the placeholder is decorative)

imageDark.description: address of the picture in the dark theme; none: image

actionLabel.description: the label of the action; the link is drawn when the label and the address are both set

secondaryActionLabel.description: the label of the second action (the secondary button after the first); drawn when the label and the address are both set; empty: none

secondaryActionHref.description: the address of the second action

blocks.title: Features Simple
blocks.description: The heading, one paragraph and the features as a list (an icon disc, a title, a line): in columns under the heading or beside it, the icon on top or at the side.

variants.label: The heading beside a row of three
The heading beside a 2 x 2 grid
Icons at the side, two columns
The heading beside a list with icons at the side

model.title: FeaturesContent
model.description: Features content: the heading, a description and an ordered list of two to eight features, each with an optional icon picture, a title and a line. One object is valid in every features layout (columns under the heading, the heading beside them, markers at the side, a checklist).

description.description: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

items.description: the features, in the order they are shown

id.description: stable key of the entry (the Codex entry id)

image.description: address of the icon picture of the feature; none: the placeholder

description.description: one line about the feature; empty: none

blocks.title: Stats Simple
blocks.description: The heading, one paragraph and the figures as a list (a large value, a label, a note), in two, three or four columns, plain or on cards.

model.title: StatsContent
model.description: Stats content: the heading, a description and an ordered list of two to four figures, each with a value, a label and an optional note. One object is valid in every stats layout.

description.description: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

items.description: the figures, in the order they are shown

id.description: stable key of the entry (the Codex entry id)

value.description: the figure as it is shown (12k, 99.9%, 4.8)

description.description: a short note under the label; empty: none

blocks.title: Testimonials Simple
blocks.description: The heading, one paragraph and the quotes as a list (the words, a portrait, the name and the role): on cards in two or three columns, in rows with the portrait at the side, or centred.

model.title: TestimonialsContent
model.description: Testimonials content: the heading, a description and an ordered list of one to six quotes, each with the words, the author, a role line and a portrait. One object is valid in every testimonials layout (cards in columns, rows with the portrait at the side, one centred quote).

description.description: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

quotes.description: the quotes, in the order they are shown

id.description: stable key of the entry (the Codex entry id)

avatar.description: address of the portrait; none: the placeholder

description.description: the role and the company of the author; empty: none

blocks.title: Logos Simple
blocks.description: A short heading over the logos as a list: a wrapping row or a grid of cards.

model.title: LogosContent
model.description: Logos content: the heading and an ordered list of three to eight logos, each a picture and the name it stands for. One object is valid in every logos layout.

logos.description: the logos, in the order they are shown

id.description: stable key of the entry (the Codex entry id)

image.description: address of the logo; none: the placeholder

title.description: the name of the company (the alt text of the logo)

model.title: TeamContent
model.description: Team content: the heading, a description and an ordered list of one to twelve members. One object is valid in every team layout (two, three or four columns, plain or on cards).

description.description: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

members.description: the people, in the order they are shown

avatar.description: address of the portrait; none: the placeholder

description.description: the role or a short line about the member; empty: none

photos.description: the photos, in the order they are shown
